overview: The Medford City Council approved several capital stabilization appropriations for school maintenance and state-assisted school building projects, ordained the Medford Square Zoning District, and approved a resolution to file a public records request for a city litigation report.

items.title: Resolution 26075: Commemoration of Judy Kaplan
items.summary: Approved a resolution commemorating the life and advocacy of local resident Judy Kaplan.

items.title: Resolution 26076: Celebrating Medford Youth Volunteers
items.summary: Approved a resolution celebrating 18 local youth volunteers from St. Raphael Parish for building beds for children on the waitlist of the Bed for Every Child Program.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the tabled meeting records from March 24, April 7, and April 14, 2026.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved multiple committee reports covering residential property tax exemptions, Boston Avenue rezoning, standard compensation drafts, and municipal newsletter planning.

items.title: Paper 26079: Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriation for MSBA School Projects
items.summary: Approved a $400,000 appropriation from the Capital Stabilization Fund to fund feasibility study and schematic design costs for school building and repair projects at Missituk and Brooks Elementary Schools.

items.title: Paper 26080: MPS Capital Improvement Plan Appropriation
items.summary: Approved an appropriation from the Capital Stabilization Fund for several scheduled facility repairs and infrastructure upgrades across Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Paper 26081: Prior Year Unpaid Bill
items.summary: Approved an expenditure of $48,866.17 from current school department funds for unpaid prior-year electrical bills, amended to apply to fiscal year 2026.

items.title: Paper 26023: Medford Square District Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Ordained proposed amendments to the Medford Zoning Ordinance establishing the Medford Square District.

items.title: Paper 25189: Standard Compensation Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: Approved on first reading a proposed ordinance setting minimum compensation standards for contracted custodial and security employees.

items.title: Paper 26077: Litigation Report Public Records Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution to file a formal public records request for a comprehensive report detailing the city's litigation costs and legal actions since 2019.

items.title: Paper 26078: Common Victualler License Process Update
items.summary: Referred a resolution concerning outstanding common victualler licenses and regulatory compliance to the Administration and Finance Committee.

items.title: Paper 26082: FY27 Community Preservation Act Budget Reserve
items.summary: Approved the Fiscal Year 2027 Community Preservation Act budget reserve allocation of $2,383,387.

items.title: Paper 26083: CPA Appropriation for Tufts Park Garden Expansion
items.summary: Approved a $4,000 CPA appropriation from the general reserve to fund the expansion of the Tufts Park Community Garden.

items.title: Paper 26084: Personnel Ordinance Salary Adjustments
items.summary: Approved on first reading salary classification adjustments for several department head positions, with an amendment to align the Director of Elections to classification level CAF 15.

items.title: Paper 26085: Litigation Settlement (Subro-IQ-Norfolk and Dedham)
items.summary: Approved a $3,414.38 litigation settlement for vehicle damages and medical expenses resulting from an accident involving a fire department employee.
